svg.title: The same synthetic flux measurements as unlabeled marks and as an inspectable plot
svg.desc: Two panels show the same synthetic relative-flux measurements. The left panel shows unlabeled blue marks. The right panel supplies time in hours, normalized relative flux, uncertainty bars, a reference level, and an annotation that calls the visible dip a candidate rather than a conclusion.
